name: Morning win backs, each laid at the SP
hypothesis: The closing model expects the morning price to shorten to the SP; back where the expected CLV clears the bar, lay at the SP so the CLV is the profit.
mechanism: Morning books are thin and slow to take in what the model knows; the SP lay closes the position at the market's own close.

evidence.claim: pre-registered out-of-sample +3.54% net CLV (90% +2.86% to +4.19%) on 12,389 trades
kill switch: an S3 error reads as not stopped (fails open), checked at most once a minute
limits: GBP400 to win, GBP15-200 a horse, GBP4,000 a day, max price 200

approved.source: CLAUDE.md (live trading, the owner's decision, 30 Sep 2026); TRADING.md
